prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC eye-animation atlas in native pixel-art style.
Input image: Image 1 is the inspected 2×2 neutral source grid for NPC 080. Use it as the exact face identity, palette, shape and pixel-grid reference.
Primary request: Create one exact 2×2 atlas, 1024×560 pixels total. Each cell is 512×280 pixels and represents a 64×35 native sprite enlarged 8×. Row-major cells: top-left image-left gaze, eyes open; top-right image-right gaze, eyes open; bottom-left image-left gaze, half blink; bottom-right image-right gaze, half blink.
Subject and consistency: same NPC 080 face in every cell. Preserve original neutral expression, neutral brows through the full source brow band, brow shape and position, eye spacing, face framing, hair, background, muted brown and olive palette, pixel clusters, and all anatomy outside the eye regions. Both eyes must look horizontally in the named image direction together. Keep pupils fully inside each eye. Use compact shaded irregular stepped olive iris clusters and subdued small glints. Draw continuous natural lids; half-blink cells must show coherent upper-lid coverage while retaining readable iris anatomy.
Constraints: Keep exact 2×2 layout and 64:35 cell aspect. Preserve native hard pixel edges with no antialiasing or blur. Make only horizontal left/right gaze differences and half-lid coverage. No vertical or diagonal gaze, no extra phases, no manual one-sided iris shift, no round flat disks, no exaggerated highlights, no facial expression or brow changes, no labels, borders, gutters, text, or watermark.
